item.title: Klubbdigest, 25 November 2026
item.description:
A weekly look at dance floors in Kristiansand and Oslo: house, tech house, techno, disco and the groovy stuff in between. This issue covers the weekend of 26–29 November and the nights announced so far for December and beyond. Nights marked New are appearing here for the first time, and Updated means the lineup or ticket details have changed since last week.

This weekend, 26–29 November

In Kristiansand, Saturday is the night to go out. zvett klubbkollektiv bring organic, melodic and progressive house and techno to Vaktbua, DJ Nonfamous Tomas plays a groovy set at Foajeen, and KlubB SKAKK holds its monthly queer disco at Barrikaden. In Oslo, Friday is the strongest night: Berlin's Ritter Butzke bring Teenage Mutants to Jaeger for tech house, and Randomer plays The Villa with Fochs Koshka live. On Saturday, Rabalder's melodic and tech house trio plays The Villa.

Kristiansand

Saturday 28 November — Vaktbua
zvett klubbkollektiv: BareTom, L-DaR, Ingemann
From 21:00 · 80 kr in the first presale tier, then 120 kr online or at the door (online sales close at 21:00) · 20+
The promised sound is organic house, melodic house and techno, progressive, tech house and psychedelic techno. Of all the Kristiansand nights this weekend, it is the closest to a proper club night.

Saturday 28 November — Foajeen · New
DJ Nonfamous Tomas
22:00 · Price not listed
A DJ with 30 years behind the decks, playing a groovy, wide-ranging set built to keep the floor moving.

Saturday 28 November — Barrikaden · New
KlubB SKAKK (queer disco)
21:00–02:30 · Live DJ · Price not listed
The monthly queer disco night run by SKAKK (Skeiv Kultur Kristiansand), for anyone who wants disco and a friendly crowd.

Oslo

Thursday 26 November — Jaeger
Helt Texas: Ole HK + Tecklund + Fabian Solheim
Backyard (Gården) · 20+ · Price not listed
Jaeger's weekly Thursday house and techno warm-up for the weekend.

Friday 27 November — Jaeger
Frædag x Ritter Butzke: Teenage Mutants, Solvane & Prismode, Pahlm, g-HA & Olanskii
Doors 22:00 · g-HA & Olanskii 22:00, Pahlm 23:00, Solvane & Prismode 00:00, Teenage Mutants 01:15 · 20+ · Tickets on Tickster
A Berlin club takeover tagged house, techno and tech house, with progressive and melodic sets from Solvane & Prismode. This is the weekend's best pick for tech house.

Friday 27 November — The Villa · Updated
Randomer (UK) & Fochs Koshka (live), plus Pen Gutt
23:00–03:00 · Early bird 180 kr
Randomer plays percussive, hard-grooving techno and has a distinctive sound. Pen Gutt has now been added to the bill.

Saturday 28 November — Jaeger
Nightflight x Lyd: Olle Abstract + From Beyond (live)
Olle Abstract + From Beyond 22:00 · MC Kaman + DJ2Chaos in Diskon from 23:00 · 180 kr, free before 22:00
A disco, house and pop night that is free if you arrive early.

Saturday 28 November — The Villa
Rabalder: Julie Reistad, Emilie Lian & Tania Næss
23:00–03:00 · 150 kr at the door
A high-energy trio playing melodic house, tech house and deeper electronic sounds.

Upcoming in Kristiansand

Friday 4 & Saturday 5 December — Club 21 Skybar · New
DJ set: Diskjokke
21:00 · Price not listed
One of Norway's best-known disco and nu-disco producers is playing DJ sets on two nights in a row.

Friday 11 December — Vaktbua · New
DJ Lexie // Vaktbua klubb
21:00–02:00 · Only 25 presale tickets at 80 kr, then 100 kr at the door · 20+
Mostly techno and house, played on the fly to suit the crowd. She won Det Gode Selskab and Yoyaku's "Born to Mix" in 2025 and has played for Klubb Kosmos. Presale is capped at 25 tickets.

Saturday 12 December — Vaktbua
Glutenguten og Kaptein Månemann
Doors 19:00, music from 21:00 · 50 kr online until 21:00, then at the door · 20+
Promises progressive build-ups, nostalgic club rhythms, hypnotic soundscapes and cheeky breaks.

Saturday 19 December — Vaktbua
Thin Duc og Ylve Thon (Christmas disco)
Doors 17:00, music from 22:00 to 02:00 · 80 kr online · 20+
Vaktbua's Christmas disco night.

Saturday 26 December — Foajeen · New
Julefinn andre Ruledag: Julefinn + Karina
21:00–02:30 · 150 kr at the door
A Boxing Day party across two rooms: a lounge with Karina on downtempo, and a club room where Julefinn plays disco, techno, house, hip hop, acid, funk and italo.

Saturday 26 December — Barrikaden · New
KlubB SKAKK (queer disco)
21:00–02:30
The December edition of the monthly queer disco.

Klubb Kosmos has not announced a date after its 14 November night on any of the calendars and ticket sites this digest checks. They tend to announce on Instagram and Facebook first.

Upcoming in Oslo

Late November and early December

Monday 30 November — Jaeger
Mandagsklubben: Salas (5h solo set)
A five-hour solo set at Jaeger's long-running Monday residency.

Friday 4 December — Jaeger
Frædag x Hubbas Klubb: Leon Vynehall
Doors 22:00 · Hubbabubbaklubb DJs 22:00, g-HA & Olanskii 23:00, Leon Vynehall 01:15

Friday 4 December — The Villa
Jartegn Aptr: Trillosta (BE), Archypness (UA) & Knitre // Sweat Shop: Fråde & Guild Navigator
23:00–03:00 · 150 kr at the door

Saturday 5 December — Jaeger · New
Nightflight x Det Gode Selskab: DGS DJs
Alex Jangle + Rub800 + Tod Louie 22:00 · MC Kaman + DJ2Chaos in Diskon from 23:00
A backyard party from Oslo's rave institution, now 15 years old, tagged tech house, house and techno.

Saturday 5 December — The Villa
Logic1000 (AU)
23:00–03:00
House built on chopped R&B vocal samples and warm low end, a good match if you like your house with an R&B flavour.

Mid December

Friday 11 December — Jaeger
Frædag: Dam Swindle DJ Kicks Tour
Doors 22:00 · Øyvind Morken, g-HA & Olanskii, Dam Swindle 01:15
The Dutch duo play house, deep house and disco on their DJ-Kicks tour.

Friday 11 December — The Villa
MRD – All Night Long
23:00–03:00
An all-night set to close his 2026 residency.

Saturday 12 December — Jaeger
Sunkissed: Erol Alkan
Erol Alkan, Olanskii, Vinny Villbass, Sirkus Sunkissed · MC Kaman + DJ2Chaos in Diskon

Saturday 12 December — The Villa · Updated
Snick Snack Music X-Mas Party: Ost & Kjex (live), Trulz & Robin, Helene Rickhard, Lárus (live), Snasen (live), Boblebad & Romdrakt (live)
23:00 · The full lineup is now out. The Villa says presale tickets are very limited.

Friday 18 December — Jaeger
Frædag: FJAAK
Doors 22:00 · Olanskii (tekno set) 23:00, FJAAK 01:15

Friday 18 December — The Villa · New
Raw Rhythm x The Villa
23:00–03:00 · Lineup TBA

Saturday 19 December — The Villa · Updated
Finnebassen (all night long) // Sweat Shop: Little Miss Lucifer & Nadda
23:00–03:00 · 150 kr · Sweat Shop lineup added

Christmas and New Year

Saturday 26 December — Jaeger · New
JuleURO: Don Quan, Fabian Berg, Fredda, Lars Palmas Jr., Sofia, Nora Teslo, Synne
URO's Boxing Day takeover across both floors, tagged house, disco and balearic.

Saturday 26 December — The Villa · Updated
Schmooze Rec: Juleschmooze vol. 4
23:00–03:00 · Main room: Una & Thale, Andissimo & Minijack · Sweat Shop: Madrigal & Noralys, Ehrmantraut & Håkky
Expect italo, minimal house and acid. After three years at Jaeger, the party has moved to The Villa.

Monday 28 December — Jaeger · New
Romjulsfestivalen: Funk For Forest (live) + Storken
Doors 22:00 · Funk For Forest live at 23:00, Storken at 01:15 · Tickets went on sale 25 November

Thursday 31 December — Jaeger
New Year's Eve x Det Gode Selskab
A:G, Chris Solaris, Emma Magdalena, Ronya · MC Kaman + DJ2Chaos

Further ahead

Frædag x Bigup x Metalheadz: DJ Storm +++

This weekend, 20–21 November

The closest match this weekend to groovy house and tech house is Steve Bug at Jaeger's Sunkissed on Saturday.
